decisions: Use one project-level .flowkit/memos.json as the unique V1 Memo storage document.
Treat Memo as a generic project concern covering future ideas and real observed issues without kind/priority/tag taxonomy.
Allow source provenance to be null or hierarchical Delivery/Change/Run provenance; source never changes current formal scope.
Keep Memo outside StandardAction, CurrentAction, Run/Result and Policy; Memo presence never blocks lifecycle progress.
Require explicit Owner authority for create/promote/dismiss and no authority for get/list; reuse existing Delivery-scoped OwnerAuthorityFact rather than changing authority core.
Use open/promoted/dismissed only; defer is no-op and promoted/dismissed are terminal in V1.
Promotion records an already-established target Delivery/Change and never creates planning/OpenSpec artifacts.
Do not modify the existing 588-line Run persistence or 438-line Policy kernels for Memo implementation.
limitations: Standalone Memo mutation with no Delivery context is deferred because current canonical OwnerAuthorityFact requires deliveryId.
Crash recovery, concurrent writers, WAL/locking and generic transaction semantics are not established by the single-file proof.
Promotion target existence discovery is deferred to future Delivery/OpenSpec integration; Memo does not create or scan targets.
nonGoals: automatic Memo discovery or AI auto-persistence
Memo Standard Action or Memo Run
